slots.ev: 白天在練習場帶課，旁邊的打位也有人在打

ppl.act: 在自己的打位揮桿、彎腰放球
ppl.wear: 室內練習場的球衣、手套、球帽

slots.pl: 首爾市區室內練習場她那個固定打位，白天上課中，隔壁打位也有人
slots.pl_en: at her regular bay in an indoor driving range in central Seoul during a daytime lesson, someone in the next bay too
slots.ac: 她兩手握著桿示範握法，眼睛跟著自己的手指看
slots.ac_en: Both hands are on the club showing the grip, her eyes following her own fingers.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：記得每個學生的握桿毛病／室內練習場的固定打位不讓人
slots.of: 白色的短袖球衫配草地綠的短裙
slots.of_en: a white short-sleeved golf top with a grass-green skirt
slots.of_s: 色盤：白、草地綠／標誌性配額：球場短裙
slots.li: 練習場上方的冷白燈很均勻，每個打位都亮
slots.li_en: The cool white lighting above the range is completely even and every bay is lit.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「室內練習場的冷白光為主…明亮但膚色維持白皙」
slots.fa: 教學中，眼睛在自己的手上
slots.fa_en: Mid-lesson, her eyes on her own hands.
slots.hair_en: in a ponytail pulled through the back of a cap

slots.ev: 教完課回公寓，球具袋就靠在牆邊沒收
slots.pl: 她首爾公寓的客廳，夜裡，球具袋靠在牆邊，只開了一盞落地燈
slots.pl_en: in the living room of her Seoul apartment at night, her golf bag propped against the wall, one floor lamp on
slots.ac: 她半躺在沙發上，一手撐在扶手上，一條腿掛在沙發外面
slots.ac_en: She is half lying along the sofa with one hand on the arm of it and one leg hanging over the edge.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：球具靠在牆邊的自拍
slots.of: 白色的貼身背心配過膝襪
slots.of_en: a white fitted vest with over-the-knee socks
slots.of_s: 私下核心：貼身背心、過膝襪
slots.li: 落地燈在她側前方，客廳深處與球具袋落在暗處
slots.li_en: The floor lamp is to one side and in front of her, and the far side of the room and the golf bag fall into shadow.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「明亮清晰，但主動壓抑曬黑感」——夜間仍維持冷白膚色
slots.fa: 跟白天完全不同的溫度，看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: A completely different temperature from the daytime, looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：這個落差比戶外的短裙更有效
slots.hair_en: down out of the ponytail, with a bend where the tie was

slots.ev: 睡前那三罐防曬排在床頭櫃上，明天還是要補
slots.pl: 她公寓的床邊，夜裡，床頭櫃上排著三罐防曬
slots.pl_en: on the edge of the bed in her apartment at night, three bottles of sunscreen lined up on the nightstand
slots.ac: 她坐在床沿把其中一罐拿起來看背面的日期
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the edge of the bed with one of them picked up, checking the date on the back.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：防曬每兩小時補一次，行李裡永遠有三罐
slots.of: 米色的絲質睡衣兩件式
slots.of_en: a beige two-piece silk sleep set
slots.li: 床頭那盞燈在她正前方，房間其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: The bedside lamp is directly in front of her and the rest of the room is dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「皮膚維持冷白，強調防曬設定」

slots.ev: 下課後去市區那間運動用品店，白天門口一直有人進出
slots.pl: 她自己那台車的駕駛座，白天，正要開去球場，後座放著球具袋
slots.pl_en: in the driver's seat of her own car in the daytime on the way out to the course, her golf bag on the back seat
slots.ac: 她一手搭在方向盤上，人轉向副駕那一側拿東西
slots.ac_en: One hand rests on the wheel as she turns towards the passenger side to reach for something.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：穿搭的流量比揮桿還好
slots.of: 金色系的針織背心配白色寬褲
slots.of_en: a gold-toned knit vest with white wide-leg trousers
slots.li: 太陽在她身後的後擋風玻璃那一側，車內比車外暗一階
slots.li_en: The sun is behind her through the rear screen, and the inside of the car sits a stop darker than everything outside it.
slots.fa: 很有精神，看著副駕那一側
slots.fa_en: Full of energy, looking across to the passenger side.

slots.ev: 週末真的上球場那天，開球前在果嶺邊等
slots.pl: 週末的球場，開球前，果嶺那一側的草坡連到遠處的樹線
slots.pl_en: out on the course at the weekend before the tee-off, the slope by the green running to a tree line in the distance
slots.ac: 她一手拄著球桿站著等，重心壓在一腳
slots.ac_en: She is waiting with the club planted, her weight down on one leg.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：週末才真的上球場
slots.of: 天空藍的短袖球衫配白色短裙，戴著球帽
slots.of_en: a sky-blue short-sleeved golf top with a white skirt and a cap
slots.li: 戶外的天光很開，草地把光反上來
slots.li_en: The open daylight is wide and the grass bounces some of it back up.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「戶外期才有草地綠。明亮但膚色維持白皙」
slots.fa: 很放鬆，看著球道那一側
slots.fa_en: Relaxed, looking off down the fairway.
slots.hair_en: ponytail pulled through the cap, moving in the wind
